newsitem.title: UK: ICI drops amid cautious NatWest comment.
newsitem.headline: ICI drops amid cautious NatWest comment.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc dropped on Monday, extending recent weakness amid cautious comment from analysts at NatWest Securities, dealers said.
After visits with the company last week, NatWest said its profit forecasts "look vulnerable" and repeated a "hold" recommendation on the stock, market sources said.
Analaysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment

Dropping below the 700p level for the first time in two years, the stock was down 15-1/2p at 687 by 0911 GMT in modest volume of 473,840 shares. It touched a day's low of 685p, its lowest since March 1995.
Other brokerages were also said to have cut forecasts today, with SBC Warburg lowering its current-year estimates to 565 million stg from 635 million but repeating a "buy" rating.
Sources said there were indications from ICI that certain price increases planned for the first quarter would not now feed through until the second quarter of the year.

ICI shares have been under pressure for much of the past year and fell further last week as analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson cut the stock to "sell" from "hold." The stock also broke through a chart resistance point at 730p.
"People have been cutting numbers on the stock and they are basically just unloved," said one market-maker.
ICI reports first quarter results on April 24.
